answer: Every fresh identity must complete a sequential voyage across a single shared forge whose cooling cycles are governed by a global clock that clones cannot accelerate in parallel. The pearl-sealed voyage log binds to the identity's prior attested history and is burned at registration; the k-th clone waits k times longer on the shared forge and consumes its own unique pearl, so a farm of 100 identities pays roughly 5000 sequential delay units plus 100 unique pearls before any can earn.
